claims.value: Sentiment-Analysis-7B is a 7B-parameter autoregressive language model fine-tuned for sentiment classification of user messages directed at a service, product, or agent. It is built on mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 and fine-tuned with reinforcement learning using an LLM as a judge.
